market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: India micronutrient fertilizer market: $0.81B (2025) to $1.12B by 2030 (6.70%/yr). Global sulfur-based micronutrients: $411.9M (2023), 9%/yr (2024-2032). Standalone micronized-sulphur market size not found.
exportGeographies: Asia (per Jaishil's own claim of 30+ countries)
globalCompetitors: Sulphur Mills Limited (world's leading sulphur-based agri-input producer per its own claim)
Coromandel International (diversified agri-inputs major, also makes zinc sulphate)
market.domesticSlice: Zinc-specific sub-segment: 8.24%/yr CAGR (2025-2030); zinc was the largest micronutrient category by consumption share in India in 2022 (26.9%)

structureFacts: Soil zinc deficiency affects an estimated 36.5% of Indian soils per ICAR data (up to 60% in some states) — a structural, geography-anchored demand driver

Government Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme incentivizes sulphur and micronutrient (zinc, boron) fertilizers; from Kharif 2024, NPK fortified with Magnesium/Zinc/Boron/Sulphur was incorporated into the subsidy scheme
State-level precedent (Andhra Pradesh) has run a targeted micronutrient subsidy using Soil Health Card data to reach zinc-deficient areas — a model other states may replicate
OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute) certification is a recognized entry point for organic/export-oriented crop-input formulations

adoptionStructure.note: Demand follows the agricultural sowing calendar and government subsidy-scheme cycles rather than a hybrid-seed-style mandatory annual repurchase — soil-deficiency correction is a recurring but not strictly forced purchase

peers.name: Aries Agro Limited
peers.note: broader micronutrient/animal-nutrition player, not sulphur-specialist, but the closest listed proxy for the category

drivers: product efficacy validated against documented soil deficiency, combined with price/dosage-efficiency (cost-per-hectare matters heavily to price-sensitive farmers)
government subsidy/NBS-scheme eligibility — subsidy-listed products move faster
distributor network reach and certification (ISI, OMRI-organic, industry-body approvals)
customerValue.strongestPredictor: dosage-efficiency / cost-per-hectare — explicitly how Jaishil markets its own NutriZin 700 product
